newsitem.title: UK: Wembley confident on target for stadium win.
newsitem.headline: Wembley confident on target for stadium win.

text.p: Wembley Plc, which runs English soccer mecca Wembley Stadium, said on Friday it was confident of the London site being chosen as the new national stadium.

Manchester and Wembley were selected to go into a final round by Britain's Sports Council almost a year ago. Wembley said it had been told by the Sports Council that a decision on the location would be made by the end of 1996.
